title: Library Only
description: Keep distractions away by opting for a design that only shows your games.

details.overview: Option that allows the user to choose between a Library-Only design, or the current design.
features: An option that shows only the library.
details.notes: This would be a toggle option in the configurations page.

title: Choose Your Widgets
description: Choose which widgets you want from a collection in the configurations page.

details.overview: Personalize your launcher by selecting the widgets you actually want to use.
features: Enable or disable individual widgets.
Manage your selection from the configuration page.
Keep your launcher interface clean and personalized.
details.notes: The available widgets and final configuration options may change during development.

title: Steam Integration
description: Connect your Steam account and bring your games, playtime and game information into the application.

details.overview: A integration with Steam to get your public data to the application and track your games.
features: Your games automatically ported to the launcher's library.
Track your friends activity.
Synchronize your wishlist.
Track your achievements.
details.notes: At first, the integration will be to create a structure for the project, and only then it will become user-directioned.

title: Full Screen Option
description: Design of a new full screen version, and an option to change the resolution.

details.overview: The launcher was created in a 4:3 design, and will be improved to accept any higher resolution.
features: Go fullscreen mode with one click.
Change the resolution in the configurations page.
Add any personalized resolution (needs to be higher than 801x609).
details.notes: This is not a priority, so this update could take longer than expected.

title: Stylized Buttons and Indicator (Header)
description: Visual indicators to help you better see which button is selected.

details.overview: Indicators on the button and a sign over the selected one to help you locate.
features: If selected, the buttons have the border thickness increased.
Hover your cursor over a button and it will change its color.
updates: [UNDONE] Add the sign over the button
[UNDONE] Make the sign follow the selected button

title: Page Navigation
description: Navigate between Home, Library, Settings and their respective subpages.

details.overview: The page navigation system that allows you to choose where you want to be.
features: Navigate between three pages and at least three tabs for each.
details.notes: This feature will take a lot of time to be concluded, since every page needs changes after specific patches.
updates: [UNDONE] Make the behind-code for the buttons in the sidebar.
[UNDONE] Make the Patch Notes tab for the Home page.
[UNDONE] Make the Performance tab for the Home page.

title: Home Page (Redesign)
description: A brand new look to the home page. Much more user-directed than before.

details.overview: The old design had lots of useless features. Now, the new design is much more useful and cleaner.
features: 2 (default) or more widgets design.
Choose your own widgets and home page layout.
details.notes: The previous appearance had design issues and widgets only to fill blank spaces, so we chose to improve it by redesigning this section. Still a subject to change.

title: More Widgets
description: New designs for the Choose Your Widgets planned feature.

details.overview: More widgets allows the user to personalize more the launcher and make it feel like their own environment.
features: Recent Achievements widget.
Pinned Games widget.
Activity widget.
Next Goal widget.
Updates widget.
Recently Played widget.
Lists widget.
What Should I Play? widget.
details.notes: There will also be an option to create your own widgets in the future.
updates: [DONE] Defined what each widget will be

title: Profile Flyout and Customization
description: Click your profile picture to open a flyout where you can change your photo and name.

features: Profile flyout.
Stores the profile image and name locally.
Accepts any image file format.
details.notes: Subject to changes, but the main idea is completed.

title: Exit Button and Adjustable Width (Sidebar)
description: Click the button in the corner left to close the application immmediately. Drag the vertical line to choose the sidebar width.

features: Exit button in the corner left.
Adjustable width for the sidebar.
details.notes: The width has limits (unable to go less than the default and more than 300px) for development sake. The release version will allow you to toggle it off in the configurations page.

title: Selection Indicator (Sidebar)
description: A visual indicator to help visualize in which page you currently are on the sidebar.

features: A small rectangle on the left that follows the selected page.
Smooth animation and fixed position.
details.notes: Probably will change to triangle in the release.

title: Stylized Buttons (Header)
description: The home page header now has its own working stylized buttons.

features: If a button is selected, you will be able to see the border thickness increasing.
If you hover the button, it will display another color.

title: Animated Buttons (Sidebar)
description: The sidebar now has its own animated buttons.

features: Each button has a scale up animation when hovering with the mouse

title: Built-In Music Player
description: A widget that works like a media player, where you can pause, go back and skip anything you are listening to.

details.notes: During the design, we realized this widget would be too difficult to do for no reason, so the team decided to abandon this feature.
